candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old. The child has an ear problem and is having ear pain. According to the caregiver, the child has had no ear discharge. There is no pus draining from the ear and there is no tender swelling behind the ear. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have fever.
